the information transfer in Chinese stock markets is stronger in the bull, crash, post-crash, and tranquil periods than in the tranquil period.
the Chinese stock market’s information transfer is weak during the tranquil period.
the information transfer in China's stock market has been increasing since the 2008 global financial crisis.

the information transfer of the Chinese stock market.
the information flow among the sectors of the Chinese stock market.
the cross-sectoral information transfer in the stock market.

, the Chinese stock market has been experiencing a process of “information explosion.”
